title: Store Handover Standard: Condition at Handover and the Home Delivery Charge on Paid-in-Full Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
The condition recorded when a Ridgeline Special Order Services item is handed over to the customer sets the handover share of the home delivery charge on an order in a program paid in full at order.

**Clause.** Where a customer handover inspection on the order recorded damaged — functional, or wrong item, the handover share is 0; where the customer handover inspections recorded damaged — cosmetic and none recorded damaged — functional or wrong item, the handover share is 0.5; otherwise the handover share is 1.

The home delivery charge billed is multiplied by the handover share before its single rounding to the nearest cent; the share itself is never rounded.

## Terms used

- **A customer handover inspection** is a condition record on the order made at the customer handover, as distinct from the store receipt inspection.
- Every customer handover inspection on the order is read; one record of functional damage or of a wrong item is enough for the share of 0.

## Share by the handover records

| Conditions recorded at customer handover on the order | Handover share |
|---|---|
| at least one damaged — functional or wrong item, whatever else is recorded | 0 |
| damaged — cosmetic, and no damaged — functional or wrong item | 0.5 |
| good only | 1 |
| no customer handover inspection on record | 1 |

A store receipt inspection, whatever condition it recorded, does not enter this share.

## Worked figures (hypothetical charge of 79.00 before the share)

| Handover records | Share | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| one damaged — cosmetic | 0.5 | 39.50 |
| one damaged — cosmetic and one wrong item | 0 | 0.00 |
| one good | 1 | 79.00 |
